one_liner: Ranks every number by a blend of each number's latest-period rate and its long-run rate, with periods of 52 draws (about a year), weighted by how much the periods differ beyond chance.
registry_status_reason: Released by package REL-1 (releases and WF-1 design v0.1r1, owner decisions WF1-1 and WF1-2, ratified 31 October 2026). Contract runs on real data need the separate real-development gate.
short_explanation: E_8 looks at every number's history, with one weight shared by all the numbers. It splits the recent history into periods of 52 draws and measures how much more the numbers' rates vary between periods than chance alone would make them. If they vary no more than chance allows, it uses each number's long-run rate; if more, it leans towards the latest period, by exactly that much. It ranks the numbers by that value: its top pick is the highest-ranked numbers and its inverse pick the lowest-ranked, with exact ties settled by the project tie rule (TIE_SHA256_V1). Its values are model-based chances of each number being drawn, not tested for calibration. It uses only which numbers were drawn, not their order or the dates, and needs 104 earlier draws. If the draws are fair, it is not expected to beat chance.
